video.title: Mountain Weather Update 10/22, Meteorologist Chris Tomer

description: Storm system continues across the West through 10/23, but it's very warm upon arrival with high elevation freezing levels.  This storm system splits with energy going north into UT/WY/ID/MT and a southern piece that develops 10/24-10/26 in NM/CO.  Freezing levels eventually drop to lower elevations.  A cold front runs across the Northern Rockies 10/27-10/28 with snow.
